Organizers.storyTitle: Results are born on the floor
Organizers.storyLead: The judge's scorecard records every rep on the server, and the event leaderboard updates on the spot, with the same rule as the panel.
Organizers.step1Body: The judge records reps and times athlete by athlete, lane by lane. If the connection drops, the phone keeps everything and sends it when the network is back.
Organizers.step2Body: The server scores with the same rule as the panel leaderboard. Anything still partial is labelled as partial.
Organizers.step3Body: The public leaderboard and the arena big screen update on their own, heat by heat, with nobody typing results afterwards.

Help.title: How can we help?
Help.lead: The most common questions from athletes who register and compete on WODArena.

q.voucher: Where do I find my proof of registration?
q.pixPending: I paid with Pix and my registration is not confirmed
q.ranking: How do I follow the leaderboard?

a.voucher: Sign in with the email and password you created when registering. Registrations lists every registration and its proof.
a.pixPending: Pix confirmation arrives from Mercado Pago within moments. If your registration is still pending, sign in to check its status and finish the payment there.
a.changeDivision: Division changes are made by the event organiser. Get in touch through the contacts on the event page.
a.refund: Each event has its own cancellation and refund rule, set out in its rulebook. Open the rulebook on the event page and contact the organiser.
a.ranking: On the event page, under Leaderboard, or with the Live button in the mobile bar. The official result is published as soon as the judge records the workout on the scorecard.
a.password: On the sign-in screen, tap "Forgot my password" and use your registration email to get a reset link.
a.teamData: Names, box and shirt sizes are corrected by the event organiser. Get in touch through the contacts on the event page.

Help.contactOrganizer: For questions about an event (divisions, times, rulebook), contact the organiser through the contacts on the event page.
